mentions.name: terminal.click
mentions.description: A terminal emulator in Early Access that aims to bring 'dead text' to life, rethinking what terminals can do while staying fully native instead of relying on Electron-style bloat. A considered companion idea is an in-browser interactive terminal toy, giving visitors something hands-on to play with rather than dry documentation.
mentions.problem: Traditional terminals render static, 'dead' text, and modern alternatives often bring the bloat of frameworks like Electron.
mentions.source_excerpt: Early Access for a new terminal emulator [0] bringing dead text to life. It's my professional dream to evolve our conception of terminals without bringing in the bloat of, say, electron (read: staying native).

mentions.name: terminal.click
mentions.description: A terminal emulator in closed beta with a hundred users, designed to make terminals more powerful and more welcoming to beginners than existing options. Interested users can sign up to test experimental features via the project site.
mentions.problem: Terminals are tragically underpowered and hostile towards beginners.
mentions.audience: Beginners intimidated by traditional terminals, plus users interested in testing experimental features
mentions.source_excerpt:
My own terminal emulator [0] currently in closed beta with a hundred users. Reach out if you're into testing experimental stuff (info on the site.)

Terminals are tragically under powered as well as hostile towards beginners! We're moving the needle there.
